Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

bestow verb

also allot, assign, grant, confer, award, give credit for, attribute

classical

Cic. Off. 1.14: in tribuendō suum cuique (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Imp. Pomp. 52: sī ūnī omnia tribuenda sint (Lewis & Short)
Caes. BC 3.4 (Lewis & Short)

tribuō, tribuere, tribuī, tribūtum

verb, third conjugation; the thing in the accusative, the person in the dative

allot, assign, bestow; grant, pay (thanks, honour)

From tribus, properly to deal out by tribes (Lewis & Short). Of rewards and gifts, and of thanks, pardon, honour and credit.

Examples

  • in tribuendō suum cuique

    in giving each his ownCic. Off. 1.14 (Lewis & Short)

See also assign, grant, give.
